images.prompt: An ordinary realistic studio reference photograph of one clear straight-sided glass filled two-thirds with orange juice, centered on a simple pale gray tabletop. review.reason: Observed one straight clear glass of orange juice and exactly one orange slice at left. Glass rim, base and drink material are cleanly resolved with no pre-existing splash or text.

images.actual_source_analysis: Observed source: one tall clear straight-sided drinking glass is centered slightly right on a light-gray tabletop, viewed at a modest downward angle. The circular rim appears as a clean ellipse. Opaque orange juice fills about two-thirds of the usable inner glass height, with a clear meniscus and empty transparent space above. The glass has a thick transparent base and vertical reflections on its sides. Exactly one thin circular orange slice lies flat to the lower left, fully visible and separate from the glass. Background is plain soft gray; illumination is diffuse from upper left with a faint gray shadow to the right of the glass. No hand, straw, labels, lettering or watermark is visible. Preserve the single glass, its straight geometry, rim and base, juice color and principal viewpoint. A controlled juice splash and limited matching fruit accents are permitted by the effect recipe, without introducing duplicate glasses.
